summary: SOL Strategies Inc., a Toronto-based digital asset infrastructure firm listed on the CSE (HODL) and Nasdaq (STKE), furnished a Form 6-K containing Exhibit 99.1, a corrective news release dated November 5, 2026. The release clarifies the company's investor relations engagement with KCSA Strategic Communications—effective November 1, 2026, four-month initial term, US$10,000 monthly fee—and announces management participation at the Cantor Convergence conference in Miami Beach (November 10-12) and Solana Breakpoint 2026 in London (November 15-17), including a Block Zero validator summit sponsorship. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is routine IR and conference disclosure, not a special situation.
